A real generated wave manifest has: "preChecks": [["/opt/homebrew/bin/supabase","start"]] (an array of argv arrays) and "checks": [{"name":"tests","argv":["npx","vitest","run"],"affectedArgv":["npx","vitest","run","{affected}"],"timeoutMs":900000},{"name":"typecheck","argv":["npm","run","typecheck"],"timeoutMs":600000,"cleanDirs":[".next/types"]},{"name":"lint","argv":["npm","run","lint"],...},{"name":"build","argv":["npm","run","build"],...}], with profile.verify {"command":["npx","vitest","run","{tests}"], setup: [...]}.
Fix the vetted set and shapes, still failing closed:
1. Vetted argvs = union of: every checks[].argv in coordination/checks.json; managedChecks(profile.verify) from tools/verify-config.mjs (its checks[].argv AND checks[].affectedArgv, and its preChecks argv arrays); profile.verify.command and each verify.setup entry; deriveQualityChecks from tools/quality-checks.mjs for this project (read package.json at root for pkg, hasTsconfig = tsconfig.json exists, config = profile.quality; detect the manager the same way the swarm does: find where tools/scope-commands.mjs calls deriveQualityChecks and reuse that exact logic, extracting a small exported helper into tools/quality-checks.mjs if needed). profile = .project-swarm.json's profile.
2. preChecks accepts an array whose entries are either an argv array or an object {argv, name?, timeoutMs?}; each argv must be vetted.
3. A check entry may only have the keys name, argv, affectedArgv, timeoutMs, repeat, base, cleanDirs. argv and affectedArgv (when present) must each be vetted. cleanDirs, when present, must equal exactly ['.next/types'] and only on a check named typecheck (that is the only one the generator writes). Any other key or shape is refused (fail closed) with a reason naming the key.
4. Job-level checks/setup/preChecks/mutantCheck: same rules as top level; shell jobs and *-shell models stay refused.
Tests in tests/om-manifest-guard.test.mjs: a temp project with package.json scripts {typecheck, lint, build}, tsconfig.json, and profile.verify {command:[npx,vitest,run,{tests}], setup:[[supabase,start]]}; the exact wave manifest shape above passes; changing any argv item, adding an unknown check key (e.g. env or cwd), cleanDirs other than ['.next/types'], or a preChecks argv not from verify.setup each fails; an affectedArgv not derived from verify fails.
